segments.name: Branded Spirits
segments.description: Produces and sells a portfolio of branded spirits across price tiers to distributors and state governments that control alcohol sales.
segments.evidence: Our Branded Spirits segment consists of a portfolio of high-quality brands, which we produce through our distilleries and bottling facilities and sell to distributors or to state governments that directly control the sale of alcohol.

segments.name: Distilling Solutions
segments.description: Processes corn and other grains into food grade alcohol and co-products, and provides barrel warehousing and blending services to spirits customers.
segments.evidence: We process corn and other grains (including rye, barley, wheat, barley malt, and milo) into food grade alcohol and distillery co-products, such as distillers feed (commonly called dried distillers grain in the industry), which are produced at our distilleries in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, and Bardstown, Kentucky.

segments.name: Ingredient Solutions
segments.description: Produces specialty and commodity wheat starches and wheat proteins sold to food processors, distributors, and bakeries.
segments.evidence: Our Ingredient Solutions segment consists primarily of specialty wheat starches, specialty wheat proteins, commodity wheat starches, and commodity wheat protein products which are sold to customers pursuant to purchase orders.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by distributors, state governments, spirits manufacturers, and food processors or bakeries under customer contracts, purchase orders, and spot-market sales for branded spirits, bulk distilled products, warehousing services, and wheat-based ingredients.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales are pursuant to customer contracts and purchase orders.
